$comment: Product releases, newest first: the one source for every current-release mention on the site. Read from the product's CHANGELOG.md at each tag (docs/claims.md C-REL-1..4). title is the first line of the release's CHANGELOG section (0.6.1 has only a Fixed list). 0.5.0 was never tagged (CHANGELOG: "never tagged or published"), so its tag is null. W6: bundle and sbom are the signed release's facts, each value copied from a command's output on the bundle itself (sha256sum, stat, the .sha256 file, the SBOM's specVersion and components; night C's report quotes them): /verify/ shows them. Releases without them (no bundle on the build host) show none. W8: summary_en is the first sentence of the release's CHANGELOG section as scripts/sync-changelog.mjs derives it (the summary in src/content/changelog/en/<version>.md; tests/changelog.spec.ts compares them), wave numbers and backticks dropped; summary_he says the same in Hebrew (docs/copy/he-review.md). Both cite summaryClaim (C-NOTES-1).
